notes: The Cu-Ag system is used as the first OBGEL exemplar because it demonstrates strong positive excess Gibbs energy, a eutectic, and limited mutual solid solubility. The phase models use the Ag-Cu binary interaction parameters reproduced by Kusoffsky (2002), with the composition convention transformed to x_Cu for OBGEL, and canonical schema-0.2.0 SGTE pure-element reference functions from Dinsdale (1991). Embedded reference-state contributions remain temporarily as a backward-compatible regression baseline. Assessment statements apply only to liquid/FCC. BCC/HCP are separately labeled constructed legacy teaching candidates with L0=30000 J/mol, not assessed interactions. Phase inventory does not imply assessment status.

temperatureValidity.notes: Intersection of all four declared phase ranges and canonical unary coverage; candidate ranges do not assert assessed binary validity.
